 Urgent Park Outside Recall Placed On Over 720,000 BMW Vehicles
 Moisture can enter the live connecter over time and cause a short circuit, even when the car is parked and turned off.
 1 hour ago 
 Annelyn Russ , 
 An urgent “park outside” recall has been placed on over 720,000 BMW vehicles.
 The recall was placed due to a risk of fire from an electrical connector on the water pump. Moisture can enter the live connecter over time and cause a short circuit, even when the car is parked and turned off.
 Owners should keep their vehicles outdoors and away from structures until the issue is fixed. You can take you vehicle to a dealership for repair.
 The recall covers:
 2012-2016 BMW 3 Series
 2012-2016 BMW 5 Series
 2012–2015 BMW X1
 2012-2016 BMW Z4
 2013-2017 BMW X3
 2014-2016 BMW 2 Series coupe
 2014–2016 BMW 3 Series sportswagon
 2014-2016 BMW 328xi Gran Turismo
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series convertible
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series coupe
 2015-2016 BMW 2 Series convertible
 2015-2016 BMW 4 Series gran coupe
 2015-2018 BMW X4
 2016-2018 BMW X5 xDrive40e
